page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 3.1 GHz. It features 2 physical cores with 2 vCPUs, providing a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, translating to 4.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or a GPU, and operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core processing is moderate, with stress-ng single-core CPU performance and gzip compression single-threaded operations scoring in the average range. However, multi-core performance is limited, with stress-ng multi-core CPU performance, PassMark CPU scores, and PassMark database operations falling into the bottom 10% tier. Memory bandwidth is also constrained, with large-block read and write speeds measuring 13.81 GB/sec and 12.07 GB/sec respectively, both placing in the bottom 10%.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation and 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance represents an entry-level general-purpose hardware profile. While it avoids the CPU credit limitations of burstable instances, its low multi-core and memory bandwidth capabilities present a significant performance tradeoff for resource-heavy applications. It is best suited for lightweight, single-threaded workloads, basic web serving, or small-scale development and testing environments that require dedicated CPU resources but do not demand high memory throughput or parallel processing power.
